text: The invoice for Northwind Retail's 18 seats shows the old VAT ID even though we updated it in the portal last week; procurement cannot process it without correction.
Could you confirm where the credit note for Beacon Health's duplicate seat fee will land, since the person who received the payment confirmation left and their email is now disabled?
Can you send Wattle & Co.'s October invoice as a PDF to their new finance contact, because the current one still goes to a former employee?
Atlas Mobility's card expired and their Enterprise renewal failed twice; we need a secure way to update the payment method today so the annual contract does not lapse.
We noticed Luma Labs was charged for 25 seats but their workspace shows 22; can you review the proration line before next cycle?

The Shopify connector for Olive Market has stopped ingesting orders since 09:00 UTC, and 40 scheduled reports for their retail dashboard are empty; we also have a pending quote for two more seats tied to the same client, so this is blocking onboarding.
Postgres sync for Juniper Telecom is delayed by about 90 minutes for the orders table, causing last night's dashboard to miss new rows.
Could you add a hover state for date filters in our Solstice Analytics workspace? Two analysts keep mistaking applied dates for draft dates.
The mobile app for Harborview Clinics keeps signing us out after switching between the Acme and Harborview workspaces, making scheduled report approvals hard to finish before Friday.
After enabling 2FA for Brightline Studio's four seats, two users get a token mismatch error during login, so we are unsure if this is a security setting or a broken session.
All five administrators for Cascade Foods are locked out after rotating SSO certificates, and nobody can approve invoices or change workspace owners.
Please help reassign the owner role for the Tidewater Law client from Priya to Marcus because Priya is leaving and currently holds the only admin seat.
Can you update the display email for our Cobalt Design workspace profile from hello@cobalt-studio.example to ops@cobalt-studio.example?

After reactivating the Tidewater Law workspace, its owner cannot assign two recovered seats because the license page keeps prompting for a new plan; we need help restoring access without starting a purchase.
Our team cannot reset the password for the legal reviewer at Fable Publishing because the recovery email goes to an archived distribution list.
Fernwood Group's procurement team needs a signed quote for 40 Enterprise seats and annual billing by tomorrow morning to release the purchase order.
Kestrel Analytics wants a demo of the BigQuery connector for a 25-seat expansion this week; their data team is already blocked waiting on approval.
Northstar Legal has 18 active seats but needs 24 before Monday, and the owner is asking whether the upgrade will preserve SSO mappings and existing roles; we need a quote fast.
Can you share the per-seat price difference between Team and Enterprise for 12 seats with annual billing?
We would like a short call next month to review renewal options for Juniper Telecom's 30 monthly seats.
We are writing a short case study about using scheduled reports across multiple client workspaces; who should we contact for permission?
A potential partner asked whether we can co-host a webinar for their Shopify integration team; if not, could they talk to someone about reseller pricing for their 15 client seats?
Please remove our agency's shared mailbox from the Lumen newsletter list and keep only the operations lead subscribed before the next quarterly digest.
We submitted an app for the mobile reliability role yesterday, but the confirmation went to an old recruiter address; can you forward it to the current hiring contact?
The feedback button on the dashboard redirects to a 404 page; we have a small idea for report templates and cannot submit it.
